title: Harrington has seen lasers that could bring down almost anything

tellings.quote: >> I mean I I have seen laser technology that could bring down almost anything.

plain: The US Secretary of Energy, John S. Herrington, says he has seen laser technology that could bring down almost anything. He says so from his own experience in office, speaking with Jesse Michels in 2026. It comes up as a hint at how far secret weapons work has gone, perhaps far enough to bring down unknown craft.
